entities.summary: Brighton Toy and Model Museum is an independent toy museum situated in Brighton, East Sussex. Founded in 1991, the museum holds over ten thousand toys and models, and occupies four thousand square feet of floor space within four of the early Victorian arches supporting the forecourt of Brighton railway station.
